description: Context handed to the TmChat.MessageTemplate render fragment for every message it renders. The template receives everything TmChat knows "around" the message — the message itself, whether the current user sent it, whether it is rendered inside the thread panel, its position and group position — plus a DefaultContent fragment with the built-in message row, so a host can take over only special message kinds and fall back to the default look for ordinary messages. TmChat never interprets Kind, Metadata or Payload; they exist purely for the template.

members.name: Message
members.description: The message being rendered, including its host-owned Kind/Metadata/Payload.

members.name: IsOwn
members.description: Whether the message was authored by TmChat.CurrentUser (an "own" message).

members.name: InThread
members.description: Whether the message is rendered inside the thread panel (the thread root or one of its replies) rather than in the root conversation list.

members.name: Index
members.description: Zero-based position of the message within the sequence it is rendered in — the root conversation list, or the thread sequence when InThread is true.

members.name: IsFirstInGroup
members.description: Whether the previous rendered message had a different author or a different Kind. The first message of a group can show its full metadata; continuation messages typically hide repeated author names and timestamps.

members.name: DefaultContent
members.description: Render fragment with the built-in message row exactly as it renders without a template — returning it from the template keeps the default look for messages the host does not take over. The fragment does not include the message wrapper (the element carrying the data-message-id anchor); TmChat renders that around template output either way.

methods.name: PayloadAs
methods.description: Returns the message's Payload typed as T, or default when the payload is null or of another type. No conversion is attempted — cast to the exact type the host stored on the message.

methods.name: GetMetadata
methods.description: Reads an entry from the message's Metadata cast to T, or fallback when the key is missing, the value is null or of another type. No conversion is attempted — store and read the same type.
